_comment: Retail metrics as AWS Context Ontology Accelerator (COA) CreateMetric request bodies (POST /namespaces/{namespaceId}/metrics). Field names and enums follow COA v0.3.8 models/src/main/smithy/metric-service.smithy. Replace dataSourceId with your registered source. Each metric binds to ONE source table, so discount_amount (needs products) is not a Tier-1 metric here.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.description: Sum of quantity * unit price actually paid (not list price).

dialects.expression: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS revenue FROM retail.order_lines
SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS revenue FROM retail.order_lines

aiContext.instructions: Revenue uses the price paid on each order line, which can be below the product list price.

metrics.name: units_sold
metrics.label: Units sold
metrics.description: Total quantity across all order lines.

dialects.expression: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM retail.order_lines

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: Orders
metrics.description: Number of distinct orders (never count order lines).

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM retail.order_lines
SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS average_order_value FROM retail.order_lines

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: Buyers
metrics.description: Customers with at least one order.

dialects.expression: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS buyer_count FROM retail.orders
SELECT AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM retail.reviews
